description: Shell script providing utility functions for managing Docker Compose configurations, environment sourcing, permission checks, and version detection within the Thingsboard project.

methods.name: additionalComposeArgs
methods.description: Determines additional Docker Compose arguments based on the DATABASE environment variable.

methods.name: additionalComposeQueueArgs
methods.description: Determines additional Docker Compose arguments based on the TB_QUEUE_TYPE environment variable.

methods.name: additionalComposeMonitoringArgs
methods.description: Returns monitoring-related Docker Compose arguments if monitoring is enabled.

methods.name: additionalComposeCacheArgs
methods.description: Determines cache-related Docker Compose arguments based on the CACHE environment variable.

methods.name: additionalStartupServices
methods.description: Lists additional startup services based on DATABASE and CACHE environment variables.

methods.name: additionalComposeEdqsArgs
methods.description: Returns Edqs-related Docker Compose arguments if EDQS_ENABLED is true.

methods.name: permissionList
methods.description: Generates a list of directory permissions based on environment variables.

methods.name: checkFolders
methods.description: Checks existence and ownership of specified directories, optionally creating and chowning them.

methods.name: composeVersion
methods.description: Detects whether Docker Compose V1 or V2 is available.
